ops.parking: The parking lot is inside Toranomon Hills Mori Tower. For in-building use other than staying overnight, the rate is 200 yen per 15 minutes. Guests attending a banquet receive a parking service ticket that is free for up to 4 hours. Valet parking (reception 7:00-23:00) costs 2,000 yen per day, and the parking fee is charged separately. Barrier-free parking spaces are available. (Source: official access page, Hyatt parking and access page, Hyatt FAQ)
ops.catering: The hotel provides catering services only for events held inside the hotel. Catering to outside venues is not offered. (Source: Hyatt FAQ)
ops.restaurants: The restaurants in the hotel are The Tavern Grill & Lounge on the 51st floor, BeBu on the 1st floor, the SUSHI and the Rooftop Bar on the 52nd floor, and the Pastry Shop on the 1st floor. The official site states that parties of up to 100 guests can be held at The Tavern Grill & Lounge and up to 80 guests at BeBu.
